enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Legendary Accuracy +2: Passive: +2 Legendary bonus to attack rolls
Slashing 4: The edges of this weapon are sharpened, dealing an additional 4d6 slashing damage on each hit.
Gashing 8: The edges of this weapon are sharpened beyond belief, dealing an additional 8d6 slashing damage on each critical hit.
Fiery 4: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to burn with enchanted flames, dealing 4d6 Fire damage on each hit.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
